title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23779v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. translated_title: TabBioMed：一个大规模的生物医学表格学习基准
translated_abstract: 机器学习的最新进展加速了生物医学预测，但对结构化生物医学数据的评估仍然碎片化，尤其是对于具有高维、大样本量、数据缺失和类别不平衡特点的数据集。我们提出了TabBioMed，一个包含94个精选公开生物医学表格数据集的大规模基准，涵盖电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学等领域。TabBioMed通过标准化的、感知数据集特性的预处理与评估框架统一了这些数据集，实现了跨分类、回归和多目标任务的可复现比较。我们对23个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖经典基线模型、梯度提升树、神经表格架构以及表格基础模型。基础模型提供了最强的家族级预测性能。然而，其增益依赖于特定数据条件：树模型……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了大规模生物医学表格学习基准TabBioMed，统一了94个精选数据集与23个模型的标准化评估，发现表格基础模型整体预测性能最强，但其优势依赖于具体数据条件。
en_tdlr: TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark unifying 94 curated biomedical tabular datasets and 23 models under a standardized evaluation framework, shows that tabular foundation models achieve the strongest overall predictive performance, though their gains are regime-dependent.
